summary: Rithm Property Trust Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 13, 2026, disclosing estimated preliminary financial results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing provides GAAP comprehensive income ranges ($79K–$853K for Q2, losses of ($3.1M)–($2.3M for H1), earnings available for distribution, and book value per share ($30.25–$30.35). No corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign is announced. This is a routine earnings pre-announcement under Items 2.02 and 7.01, not a special situation.
